name: MCB 5108
title: Design, Interpretation, and Presentation of Biological Research
description: An exploration of experimental design, data analysis and effective presentation of research results for graduate students performing laboratory experiments in molecular and cellular systems.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required; open to undergraduates with permission of instructors. Not open for credit to students who have passed MCB 5895 when offered as Design, Interpretation, and Presentation of Biological Research.
